name: Higher or Lower
description: Guess whether the next number is higher or lower than the one on screen.

steps: A number from 1 to 99 appears on the TV.
On your phone, tap Higher or Lower to guess whether the next number will be bigger or smaller.
Then the next number is revealed. Everyone who guessed right scores.
rules.scoring: Each right guess is 100 points, plus up to 100 more for answering quickly.
